title: eludite.navigation.file_structure input
description: File Structure (Ctrl+F11; Alt+\, Visual Studio's Go To Member): a popup over the editor listing the document's symbols with a filter box; Up, Down and Enter navigate, Escape closes.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

select.description: Navigate to symbol `select` (0-based, in the depth-first order of the output's flattened `symbols`) and close the popup.
